steps.title: Lists inside lists
steps.body: Bullets, numbered lists and to-dos now nest. Tab moves an item under the one above it, Shift+Tab brings it back out, and each level numbers itself. Copying or dragging the list keeps it nested in the Markdown.

keys.text: on a list item: one level deeper
on an empty nested item: one level out

steps.title: Move blocks from the keyboard
steps.body: With the caret in any block, or several blocks selected, move them up and down, duplicate them or delete them without reaching for the mouse.

keys.text: move the block, or the selection
